class_id: a narrow writer routed through a whole-row save writes columns it never claimed
feature: any writer that owns only some columns of a table (the opening-day check owning name/status/open/close on `ipos`, the field-plan walk owning one field) but writes through a shared save path that rebuilds the whole row from its payload
symptom: the caller narrows its CLAIM (only these fields enter the priority decision), but the save that follows builds the full column set: every column the decision did not produce falls back to the raw single-source payload or a constant, and the repository applies it with a plain whole-object SET. A source that says less than the stored row therefore overwrites the stored row with what it said: one exchange's list turns a stored two-exchange listing into one exchange, a source with no segment writes a segment, every save stamps lastScrapedAt. Universal shape: narrowing what a write CLAIMS is not narrowing what it WRITES; only a SET clause built from the claimed fields is.
first_seen: 2026-09-24 -- IPODhan item 7 S4 round 3 (head 3434fa9c). The opening-day writer passed `onlyFields` = companyName/status/openDate/closeDate to `DataConsolidationOrchestrator.consolidatedUpsertIPO`; `extractConsolidatedData` / `extractListingExchanges` fell back to the raw scrape (`toListingExchangesForSource`) and `IPORepository.update` (`packages/shared/src/repositories/ipo-repository.ts` ~1187) ran `.set({...data})`. Probe: a stored row with listingExchanges ['NSE','BSE'] and segment 'MAINBOARD', written by the NSE list then the BSE list, ended as ['BSE']; the same save also wrote segment and lastScrapedAt. Reproduced red by `scraper/tests/unit/scheduler/opening-day-strict-write.test.ts` (CORE case: expected ['BSE'] to deeply equal ['NSE','BSE']) on 3434fa9c, green after the strict writer. Shared path tracked in issue #951.
fix_prs: item 7 S4 round 4 (branch feat/item7-s4-opening-day-check): the opening-day check no longer calls the whole-row save; it asks the field-priority matrix (`DataConsolidationService.consolidateIPOData`) for the four fields and SETs only the decided values that differ from the stored row. The shared consolidated save was fixed separately on branch fix/951-consolidated-save-unclaimed-fields (2026-09-26): `extractConsolidatedData` drops every key outside the write's claim (the keys of the consolidated incomingData) on an UPDATE, and `extractListingExchanges` returns nothing for an unclaimed listingExchanges; lastScrapedAt stays as bookkeeping the write owns.
